name: Manatsu Kotone
source: A confident, intelligent, hot-blooded tomboyish girl who's Akito's childhood friend and current girlfriend. She's extremely popular with her peers and is even considered to be the "idol" of her school, she enjoys helping out various sports club and is also extremely powerful being undefeated at her grandfather's dojo.
